steps.action: Place the red 2x2 plate in the center between the blue bricks and lay the two lime tiles on either side of it, running front to back.
watch_for: Tiles go on both sides of the red plate, parallel to each other
Red plate must be centered between the two green tiles, not offset

steps.action: Add one blue 1x4 brick along the left back edge and one along the front edge of the baseplate to close in the seat.
watch_for: Front brick sits at the front edge, beside the existing right-front blue brick
Left brick continues the back row, lined up with the existing blue brick
